Promptr Studio Pro 5.84

  • Cancel a running CRAFTR operation. The spinner now carries a small x. One click stops the operation immediately and leaves the editor unchanged.
  • Drop an image on the prompt editor. A bar appears with two actions: Image prompt writes a complete prompt that recreates the image, Apply style takes only lighting, colour, camera and mood and applies them to the existing prompt.
  • Multi-selection drag to the Finder. Dragging several selected assets into the Finder now copies every file instead of creating a text file.

Promptr Studio Pro 5.83

  • Kling with a start image: the format follows the image. Kling's image-to-video routes have no format setting, the video always takes the format of the start image. The format chip disappears in the start-image modes and a small info chip explains it.
  • Kling O3 with a reference video: choose the format. The format chip offers "auto" (the format of the reference video, preselected) plus 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1. Kling O3 4K keeps following the reference video.

Promptr Studio Pro 5.82

  • Seedance 2.5 with a reference video: choose the task. A Task chip appears once a reference video is attached: Auto lets Seedance decide from the prompt, Reference uses style and motion with your own length and format, Edit changes the video with length and format taken from it, Extend continues the video. The task is sent explicitly, so mismatched settings are rejected right away instead of after the job was accepted.
  • MOV output for Seedance 2.5. The Format chip switches between MP4 and MOV. Edit and Extend preselect MOV to preserve the quality of the source clip; you can switch back.
  • Last frame as an image. The Last frame chip delivers the final frame of the video as a separate image asset next to the video, ready as the start frame of the continuation.
  • Asset markers. The Insert marker chip puts @Image 1, @Video 1 or @Audio 1 into the prompt at the cursor, numbered in the order of the reference lists.
  • Thumbnail size in steps. The two image icons next to the gallery zoom slider step the thumbnail size smaller or larger with one click.
